Dun-dun-dun-duuun♪ This is Agent Mar. 
Target confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is Chan-Me mimicking the movie she 
saw yesterday. Feeling like an agent 
speeding off in the Chan-Me car to execute 
a top-secret mission.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if being a mascot wasn't my true 
calling, perhaps Chan-chan would have 
aimed to become Agent Chan-chan.
